description: River channel migration and characteristics from 1988 to 2019 at 74 bridges in the Philippines is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. The data set contains the Philippines bridge inventory, river migration geodatabase and source code to assess active river channel change (i.e. planform adjustments) using Landsat 5, 7 and 8 products in Google Earth Engine. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Dice similarity coefficient, Fluvial geomorphology, Jaccard index, RivWidthCloud, river migration. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
